$comment: Single source of truth for the Skeleton API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Grey shapes that stand in for content while it loads.

width / height.description: Size each shape like the content it replaces.

examples.title: Profile
examples.description: A round picture and two lines of text.

examples.title: Card
examples.description: A media block, a title, text and a button, inside a Card.

examples.title: List
examples.description: Repeat a row for a list. Vary the line widths so it looks like text.

a11y: Wrap the shapes in one element with role="status" and an aria-label ("Loading profile"), so screen readers hear one message, not a list of empty boxes.
Remove the skeleton when the content arrives; the real content takes its place.
The shimmer stops when the user asks for reduced motion.
